May 11, 2018 - By Darrin Black
Spf Beheer Bv decreased its stake in Amerisourcebergen Co (ABC) by 2.01% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Spf Beheer Bv sold 16,013 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.14% with the market. The institutional investor held 781,359 shares of the other pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $71.74M, down from 797,372 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Spf Beheer Bv who had been investing in Amerisourcebergen Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $18.87B market cap company. The stock increased 0.39% or $0.33 during the last trading session, reaching $85.86. About 995,238 shares traded. AmerisourceBergen Corporation (NYSE:ABC) has declined 3.97% since May 11, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 15.52% the S&P500.

The institutional investor held 824,786 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $139.58M, up from 650,827 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
